name: Epigral Limited
summary: Epigral Limited is a chemical company producing chlor-alkali products and derivatives for sale worldwide. These include CPVC resins, epichlorohydrin, chloromethanes, hydrogen peroxide, caustic soda, chlorine and caustic potash, and it also trades agrochemicals. Its customers span CPVC pipes, wind energy, construction, paints, electronics, water treatment and pharmaceuticals.
